title: SAP Emarsys pricing - Two-edition contact-based model
clean_text: Emarsys Edition costs $1,500 to $5,000+ per month depending on contact database size, ranging from $18K/year for up to 50K contacts to $144K+/year for 1M+ contacts. Enterprise Edition costs $5,000 to $15,000+ per month and requires an existing SAP CX footprint. Implementation costs range from $30K to $80K for standard Emarsys Edition deployments, $80K to $200K for advanced deployments, and $100K to $300K+ for Enterprise Edition with full SAP integration.

meta.pricing_model: contact-based with channel add-ons, two editions
